title: What's New at Scispot: Exciting Updates You Should Know About [2024]
summary: We release new innovative upgrades on a weekly basis, providing the best modern alternative to outdated ELN and LIMS products.
body_markdown:
At Scispot, we are always looking to improve our platform based on the feedback we receive from our users. This June, we’ve rolled out some exciting new features that enhance compliance, automation, data migration, and integration.


Here’s a look at what’s new:


‍


## **Convert Files into Interactive Experiments**


Migrating flat files like PDFs, .docx, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and .xlsx into Scispot has never been easier. With Scispot AI, you can transform these files into ready-to-use protocols, inventory managers, sample managers, and results tables. Imagine seamlessly integrating your experimental protocols from Google Docs directly into Scispot apps.


‍


‍


‍


## **Search Contextually with Natural Language Prompts**


Our AI-assisted search feature allows you to find information using natural language prompts. For instance, if you’re looking for "experiments where CRISPR was used to edit the BRCA1 gene," just type it in, and Scispot will instantly locate all relevant records. This feature goes beyond simple keyword matching, offering intelligent, context-aware searches tailored to scientific queries.


‍


‍


‍


## **Extract Insights from Your Data in Real-Time with AI Assistance**


Scibot is now capable of generating growth curves, dose-response analyses, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic modeling, high-content screening analysis, and multi-parameter flow cytometry data analysis. It offers advanced plotting capabilities like heat maps and 3D molecular structures to help you visualize and interpret complex data. For example, Scibot can instantly analyze your data and produce detailed visualizations for a new drug candidate’s dose-response curve.


‍


‍


‍


### **Bring Your GraphPad Analytics into Scispot**


You can now automatically extract data and graphs from GraphPad Prism projects and embed them into your Scispot experiment pages. This integration ensures all your data and visualizations are accessible in one place. For example, you can directly link GraphPad-generated survival curves or bar graphs to specific experiments in Scispot.


‍


‍


‍


### **Connect Scispot with 6,000+ Apps via Zapier**


We’ve made it possible to connect Scispot with over 6,000 popular apps via Zapier. This feature allows you to automate tasks and save time without needing to code. Find Scispot on Zapier and streamline your workflows effortlessly.


‍


‍


‍


### **Why Choose Scispot?**


Scispot is dedicated to streamlining lab management and enhancing research efficiency. Labs around the world choose Scispot for its seamless integration with various tools and apps, making data easily accessible. With 1-click import from PDFs, Google Docs, spreadsheets, and more, Scispot simplifies data import like no other ELN and LIMS system. Our AI-powered platform reduces manual errors and enhances efficiency through AI-assisted global search and real-time data analysis with Scibot, enabling instant generation of growth curves, dose-response analyses, and complex visualizations.


Scispot integrates with over 7,000 apps and hundreds of instruments, including Hamilton robots and Thermo Fisher mass spectrometers. Automation features, such as bulk updates in Labsheets and extensive app integrations via Zapier, boost productivity. Advanced computational tools like embedded Jupyter Notebook and GPT-4 provide powerful resources for data analysis. Our White Glove Support offers unlimited training, data migration, and consulting with transparent pricing and volume-based discounts, ensuring you are not charged extra as your needs evolve.


Choosing Scispot means joining a community of forward-thinking scientists with continuous support and platform improvements to meet the ever-changing needs of the scientific community.
